funding.what_it_covers: Council’s own funding of the remaining 40% of project costs; evidence does not specifically allocate additional money to this operator-withdrawal event or any resulting gap.

source_refs.quote: The Town Council funds the balance from its own capital reserves.
No other grant is being sought, so no fundraising work package is needed.

decision.who: Harbourline Town Council; the evidence does not identify a specific decision-maker for the procurement response.
decision.what: Decide the procurement action following withdrawal of the sole active ageing EOI respondent, including whether and how to proceed given the three-response requirement.
decision.amount_or_date: Before the extended EOI closing date of 30 April 2027.
decision.sentence: Harbourline Town Council must decide the procurement action for the active ageing operator following the sole respondent’s withdrawal, before the extended EOI closes on 30 April 2027.

unresolved.item: Whether the EOI will receive any further eligible submissions and whether the procurement policy’s three-response minimum can be met.
unresolved.would_be_settled_by: The procurement response and outcome at the extended 30 April 2027 closing date.

unresolved.item: Revised active ageing operator appointment date and accountable owner for the active ageing operator agreement deliverable.
unresolved.would_be_settled_by: A Council procurement decision, appointment record, and assigned agreement owner.

unresolved.item: Whether the T2 signed-agreement condition can be met on the construction programme’s timing, and the resulting effect on tranche release.
unresolved.would_be_settled_by: A dated, integrated schedule for appointment, signed agreements, structural/M&E rough-in, and T2 condition assessment.

unresolved.item: Any incremental cost or schedule effect caused by the withdrawal; the historical S$85,000 room-reconfiguration example is not a project estimate for this event.
unresolved.would_be_settled_by: A scoped and priced proposal plus a revised programme from the responsible procurement and design parties.

unresolved.item: Whether contingency is formally designated and whether the Council’s capital reserves are authorized to cover any event-related incremental cost.
unresolved.would_be_settled_by: A Council budget decision allocating contingency and confirming the funding source for any approved additional cost.
